Page: AI Agent Creator Naming

A person who creates AI agents can be called different things depending on the depth and role.

## Common Names

| Name | Meaning / Usage |
|---|---|
| **AI Agent Developer** | Most common practical term |
| **AI Engineer** | Broad role building AI systems |
| **Agent Architect** | Designs multi-agent systems and workflows |
| **Agentic AI Engineer** | Modern term for autonomous-agent builders |
| **LLM Engineer** | Works specifically with large language models |
| **Automation Engineer** | If focused on workflows/tasks |
| **AI Systems Designer** | Higher-level system planning |
| **Cognitive Systems Engineer** | Enterprise/research style naming |
| **AI Orchestrator** | Coordinates multiple agents/tools |
| **Prompt Engineer** | Mainly prompt logic, not full systems |
| **Multi-Agent Systems Engineer** | Builds collaborating agents |
| **Autonomous Systems Developer** | Focus on self-operating AI |

## Startup / Product Style Titles

These are more branding-oriented:

- Agent Builder
- AI Workflow Architect
- Autonomous Operations Designer
- Digital Workforce Engineer
- AI Copilot Developer
- AI Runtime Architect
- Human-AI Systems Architect

## Enterprise Grade Naming

For serious enterprise products, companies may use:

- Principal AI Architect
- AI Platform Engineer
- Intelligent Automation Architect
- Enterprise AI Solutions Architect
- Autonomous AI Infrastructure Engineer
